description: Unit tests for the NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer, verifying detection of ref, out, and in parameters in grain interface methods within the Orleans framework. The tests include methods that check for violations, ensure correct behavior in static methods, and confirm that non-relevant methods are not flagged.

classes.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Test class that contains multiple test cases for the NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzer, focusing on various scenarios involving ref, out, in parameters in Orleans grain interface methods.

methods.name: NoRefParamsAllowedInGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Verifies that ref parameters are detected and reported as diagnostics in grain interface methods.

methods.name: NoOutParamsAllowedInGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Verifies that out parameters are detected and reported as diagnostics in grain interface methods.

methods.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerInClass
methods.description: Checks that multiple ref and out parameters in implementation classes cause diagnostics to be reported.

methods.name: NoRefParamsDiagnosticAnalyzerNoError
methods.description: Ensures that normal parameters in grain interfaces do not cause diagnostics and that non-relevant method signatures are ignored.

methods.name: OutAndRefParamsAllowedInStaticGrainInterfaceMethods
methods.description: Confirms that static interface methods with ref/out parameters do not generate diagnostics, as they are not part of distributed grain calls.
